doc.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011

title: Current goals, family and what he charges
summary: Goals to record with his band and go to Japan; he has a family; has a minimum fee.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: What do you, are you a goal-oriented person?
What are your goals right now.
My immediate goals is to record my next album, which I’m in the process of doing with my band who is Amy Bowles, Aaron Bellamy, the band you saw in Utica basically. I think they were all there.
Yeah, I think so. © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-
My original band. We’re planning on recording a new album, and then hopefully, I’ve never taken my band to Japan yet so that’s a goal.
After that you sort of deal with what happens to you.
Do you think you have — I know your wife works in Rome. Are you thinking about having a family or anything like that?
Oh yeah, yeah. I mean I have a family already.

So I definitely switched gears I guess you could say, over the past few years, where I still go out but it’s not like the grind where I might be playing every weekend and every other night. It was that way for years. I’m kind of like focused on my family and then I would go to gigs that I would say are more beneficial for me to take.

Yeah. I mean do you have a set figure in mind if someone calls you and says okay come down to New Orleans and be here for three days, and they say, and here’s what we can pay you. Do you have a set figure?
Yeah, yeah. I do. And that varies. That could vary. But yeah I don’t go for less than a certain amount I guess. Is that what you’re saying?
Sure. Yeah. I mean it’s good to have that sort of in place so that you don’t have to think too hard about it on the phone with someone.
Definitely. Uh, that sounds all right. Let me think about it. So yeah.
